title: Interval clock
description: A single enamel countdown dial depletes around an inset numeric readout, with tactile interval keys.
useCase: Focus periods, rehearsal intervals and deliberate timed activities.
interaction: Choose 1, 5 or 10 minutes; start, pause or reset.
reducedMotion: The countdown and ring update in discrete seconds; decorative button transitions are removed.
limitations: Local browser timer; no alarm, background notification or persisted session. Host pause freezes elapsed time.
look: Sage-grey rounded console: a silver-bezel clock face with minute ticks and an orange ring around large numerals, beside segmented presets and an orange start key.
motion: Pressing start counts down in whole-second steps: the orange ring and its end dot retreat counter-clockwise to twelve, the digits tick and a lamp lights; the key stays depressed.
adapt: A 100 ms `setInterval` running `tick` updates `remaining`; `progress` sets the `sf-ic-progress` circle's `strokeDasharray` and the dot position, and presets call `reset`. Change the `[1, 5, 10]` presets and hook completion to your own alert.
